topic: Capacity and cost: only public figures are pre-2022 scenario ranges (not a committed nameplate)
wiki_text: No firm baseload capacity or cost has been publicly committed for the RomGaz/SOCAR Black Sea LNG project. The figures circulating in coverage (capacity 2-8 bcm/y; cost EUR 1.2-4.5 billion across three scenarios) originate from a pre-MOU Romania Energy Center analysis ('Black Sea LNG: Dreams vs Reality', dated 2019-04-17) of the earlier AGRI-era Constanta LNG concept, and predate the October 2022 RomGaz-SOCAR MOU. They are multi-scenario planning ranges, not a disclosed nameplate or project cost, and should NOT be entered as CapacityinMtpa or Cost. A separate ~EUR 900 million figure appears in 2024 Romanian-language coverage (energyworld.ro) tied to the national energy plan listing, but that source is JS-gated and could not be verified, and again is not a confirmed FID-level cost. Leave Capacity and Cost blank until the project company discloses firm figures.
